notes: FIVE Scarlet Monastery wings is NOT supported by any source found. Every Forever source (warcrafttavern LFG list, foreverchanges, conquestcapped, lfcarry, expcarry, wowforeverguides '[4 Wings]', wowforeverleveling, zockify, Blizzard news) lists four: Graveyard, Library, Armory, Cathedral. kami-labs (beta client data) even shows SM as a single Group Finder entry. Tirisfal Glades also holds the NEW dungeon Ruins of Lordaeron (15-22 LFG, 15-20 Blizzard), which is not an SM wing. Treat the fifth wing as unverified unless the user has a screenshot.

Wing splits in the Forever LFG list (warcrafttavern table, says it mirrors the in-game Looking For Group tool): SM 4, Dire Maul 3, Blackrock Spire 2 (Lower/Upper), Stratholme 2 (Main Gate/Service Gate). kami-labs client data agrees for Dire Maul (3) and Blackrock Spire (2) but shows SM and Stratholme as single Group Finder entries: conflict, unverified which the live tool shows.

NOT split in Forever (single LFG entry, Tavern ranges): Blackrock Depths 52-60, Maraudon 46-55, Uldaman 41-51, Gnomeregan 29-38, Sunken Temple 50-60. Razorfen Kraul 29-38 and Razorfen Downs 37-46 are two separate dungeons, not wings.

New Forever dungeons have NO wings: City of Dalaran (28-35 LFG / 28-33 Blizzard; one entrance Silverpine Forest 69.3, 45.6 via sewers, Dalaran Sewer Key; a locked door skips most of it), Excavation Site: Wetlands (26-33 LFG / 24-29 Blizzard; entrance 48.1, 56.5; 'four sub-zones, one per boss', linear), Krol'dok Stronghold (40-47 LFG / 40-45 Blizzard; Riverglades cave 37.5, 37.5; alternate routes but one entrance). Also single: Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, The Drowned City, Alcaz Prison, Blackmaw Hold, Shaper's Terrace.

LFG ranges vs Blizzard ranges for new dungeons differ (e.g. Hall of Thanes 13-20 LFG vs 13-18 Blizzard): Tavern says its numbers are the in-game LFG tool brackets; foreverchanges says its Classic-dungeon ranges come from the Classic Era client's Group Finder data and are not confirmed for Forever.

Quest min levels: warcrafttavern quest guides used where given; conquestcapped tables show 58-60 for nearly every endgame quest (looks like quest level, not min level). DM, BRS, Stratholme, BRD, Maraudon were not in the level-30-capped beta, so Tavern's guides for them are Classic-based.

Usual first run per dungeon: SM Graveyard (then Library for the Scarlet Key), Dire Maul East (Crescent Key), Lower Blackrock Spire (Seal of Ascension), Stratholme Main Gate/Live (Service Gate locked until Key to the City), Maraudon orange or purple side.
Wowhead Forever quest/zone pages render their Quick Facts by JavaScript and the &xml endpoint is blocked (403) for automated fetches, so Wowhead min levels could not be read directly.
